g.text: Exact hard-zero propagation before partition-sum computation
Campaign 003 · all 324 / 324 frozen trial outcomes retained
Each protein cell shows every repeat, left to right 0 / 1 / 2: status, cold whole-pipeline wall time t, observed RSS R.
All arms reload the original model and pay their own transformation cost. Failure and enumeration-limit costs are retained.
† marks a censored timeout at recorded termination elapsed; — means no worker observation. No solver ranking is inferred.

g.text: Published computational models · fixed AA sequence · β = 1 numerical target

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Synthetic controls · high budget only · outcomes remain separate from proteins
low: 16 MiB table policy / 128 MiB RSS / 10 s row | high: 128 MiB table policy / 512 MiB RSS / 20 s row | cold preparation cap 3 s
R = maximum of sampled process-tree RSS and worker lifetime high-water through valid-result encoding/write; later stdout/sidecar allocation is sampled only.
RSS samples can miss transient/short-lived peaks and double-count shared pages. Named table policies are not whole-process memory bounds.
Nominal domain products count all Cartesian assignments after local propagation, including globally incompatible tuples; they are not exact support counts.
Scope: descriptive local feasibility, correctness status and resource costs. Synthetic controls are not protein evidence; β = 1 is not calibrated binding affinity.
No ETH implementation, novel algorithm, broad performance superiority or improved biological prediction is claimed.
